headline: Record revenue, but one-off charges dent GAAP earnings
summary_short: Q2 revenue hit an all-time record of $3.47B, up 11% y/y on 4% volume growth and higher fuel surcharges, while GAAP diluted EPS fell 4% to $3.26 on merger-related and Eastern Ohio incident charges; adjusted EPS rose 7% to $3.52.
summary_long: Revenue hit an all-time quarterly record of $3.47B, up 11% y/y, on 4% volume growth and fuel surcharges (six points of growth). GAAP income from railway operations fell 4% to $1.12B and the operating ratio worsened to 67.6% from 62.2%, driven entirely by merger-related expenses, restructuring charges, and Eastern Ohio incident costs; adjusted for those, income rose 5% and the operating ratio was 65.5%. GAAP diluted EPS fell 4% to $3.26 while adjusted EPS rose 7% to $3.52. Shareholders' equity rose q/q to $16.25B; cash fell to $1.07B. No numeric forward guidance was given.
